title: Night-theme readability and iconography consolidation for Quickstart flows
creator: Aisha Nadeem
description: This ticket scopes a full accessibility and visual polish pass against onboarding and quickstart UX assets specifically for the night-theme (dark-mode). Goal: ensure all onboarding illustrations, micro-icons, and product screenshots meet WCAG AA contrast for text and UI elements, have clear focus states, and are consistent across Quickstart flows (signup, API key, first call, sample app). Deliver a verified asset kit and new screenshot set for release notes.
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding screen mockups pass automated contrast checks (AA) for text and interactive elements
Icon set consolidated into single 24/32/48px glyph family with optimized stroke weights for dark backgrounds
Updated product screenshots captured in night-theme with real sample data and no PHI
Figma file contains final components and export-ready slices in PNG/SVG for engineering and marketing
Confluence doc updated with visual QA checklist and handshake notes for ENG to integrate assets
tasks: Run automated contrast audit on current quickstart screens (A11y CI)
Create updated icon glyphs with filled and outline variants for dark backgrounds
Produce 3 variants for each onboarding illustration: full-color, mono-high-contrast, and reduced-saturation for low-vision
Capture product screenshots on staging with feature flags for night-theme and sample prompts
Export and tag assets in Figma with naming conventions and required sizes
Coordinate with ENG to validate CSS tokens for background and text colors used in screenshots
risks: Staging data variability may cause screenshots to include real user content — coordinate with Data Ops for sanitized sample prompts
Engineers may have CSS token drift; need a small hotfix release if tokens differ from design values
Tight timeline before console-2026.03 cut: prioritize critical screens first
notes: Design exploration favored higher saturated accent at 24% to retain brand warmth while passing contrast
Decided to switch to 2px stroke for 24px icons to improve legibility on dark backgrounds
Consider small shadow lift behind illustrations when overlaid on near-black backgrounds to avoid edge blending
